problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a fleet of drones to inspect ten distinct communication towers spread across a rugged terrain.

The flight durations between towers, measured in minutes, are as follows:
* Tower Alpha to Tower Bravo: 144.4 minutes
* Tower Alpha to Tower Charlie: 237.0 minutes
* Tower Alpha to Tower Delta: 204.1 minutes
* Tower Alpha to Tower Echo: 120.5 minutes
* Tower Alpha to Tower Foxtrot: 177.2 minutes
* Tower Alpha to Tower Golf: 123.5 minutes
* Tower Alpha to Tower Hotel: 131.0 minutes
* Tower Alpha to Tower India: 188.0 minutes
* Tower Alpha to Tower Juliett: 155.4 minutes
* Tower Bravo to Tower Charlie: 145.9 minutes
* Tower Bravo to Tower Delta: 90.8 minutes
* Tower Bravo to Tower Echo: 32.2 minutes
* Tower Bravo to Tower Foxtrot: 127.5 minutes
* Tower Bravo to Tower Golf: 123.1 minutes
* Tower Bravo to Tower Hotel: 182.6 minutes
* Tower Bravo to Tower India: 56.6 minutes
* Tower Bravo to Tower Juliett: 83.5 minutes
* Tower Charlie to Tower Delta: 58.1 minutes
* Tower Charlie to Tower Echo: 139.2 minutes
* Tower Charlie to Tower Foxtrot: 69.3 minutes
* Tower Charlie to Tower Golf: 126.1 minutes
* Tower Charlie to Tower Hotel: 176.9 minutes
* Tower Charlie to Tower India: 97.1 minutes
* Tower Charlie to Tower Juliett: 82.3 minutes
* Tower Delta to Tower Echo: 91.4 minutes
* Tower Delta to Tower Foxtrot: 78.3 minutes
* Tower Delta to Tower Golf: 117.1 minutes
* Tower Delta to Tower Hotel: 178.9 minutes
* Tower Delta to Tower India: 39.0 minutes
* Tower Delta to Tower Juliett: 56.2 minutes
* Tower Echo to Tower Foxtrot: 106.4 minutes
* Tower Echo to Tower Golf: 92.6 minutes
* Tower Echo to Tower Hotel: 150.7 minutes
* Tower Echo to Tower India: 68.0 minutes
* Tower Echo to Tower Juliett: 64.1 minutes
* Tower Foxtrot to Tower Golf: 58.2 minutes
* Tower Foxtrot to Tower Hotel: 108.6 minutes
* Tower Foxtrot to Tower India: 103.3 minutes
* Tower Foxtrot to Tower Juliett: 44.0 minutes
* Tower Golf to Tower Hotel: 63.9 minutes
* Tower Golf to Tower India: 125.6 minutes
* Tower Golf to Tower Juliett: 61.7 minutes
* Tower Hotel to Tower India: 189.5 minutes
* Tower Hotel to Tower Juliett: 124.9 minutes
* Tower India to Tower Juliett: 66.4 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient inspection circuit, where each tower is visited precisely once before the drone returns to its launch point.
